params.prompt: Editorial macro photograph of a tilt-shift miniature diorama on a clean light grey desk, HO-scale model figurines in neat business clothes, soft natural daylight, calm, precise and friendly mood, very tidy composition, white paper, light grey, graphite details, turquoise #30D5C8 as the only accent colour, no logos. A big wall calendar sheet lies on the desk with several dates circled in turquoise marker; tiny accountants walk along it, one places a small flag on a date, two carry a tax declaration sheet, one sits at a tiny desk with a laptop entering numbers, one checks off a list «ЗВІТИ ЗДАНО». Orderly, routine, reassuring.
